mentions.name: Chief of Staff
mentions.description: An AI assistant for startup CEOs and busy executives that acts like a chief of staff: it reviews the calendar, incoming emails, and messages, prepares meeting briefs, drafts responses, and triages email. By sharing strategic goals it prioritizes high-leverage work, and it tracks communication frequency and sentiment so users notice when a key customer goes cold. It works out of the box by connecting Gmail, Slack, and Calendar, and keeps the user in control by letting them hit send. Currently in private beta.
mentions.problem: Communication and email triage consumes a large amount of time each day and its mental overhead takes founders away from strategic tasks; existing tools like Superhuman (user still does most of the work) and Lindy (time-consuming workflow building) fell short.
mentions.audience: Startup CEOs specifically, and executives with high email volume (100+ emails a day) in general.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Chief of Staff (getcos.ai), an AI assistant for startup CEOs specifically (and executives with 100+ emails a day in general), because neither Superhuman nor Lindy were working for me.
